# Words in prose that look like a bare file name but name no source file.
# A dependency's file is named `crate:path` and resolved in its pinned source
# (proofs/src/anchor/prose.rs); it never goes here.
#
# defradb.rs            -> this repository's name
# vera.rs               -> the Vera project's name
# registry_families.rs  -> generated by proofs/build.rs into OUT_DIR
defradb.rs
vera.rs
registry_families.rs
